messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: Error DSM
parts:
Hi Imene, hi listfolk,

This kind of error is often down to the data format being wrong. For
example if there are NA values in the response or segments/observations
that don't match up. I'd recommend ensuring that the Sample.Label and
observation columns in your data are matching up correctly.

cheers,
--dave

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Re: Error DSM
parts:
Hi Imene, hi listfolk,

Looking at the CSV file you sent, it seems that you're using , as the
decimal separator, that means that R will interpret columns with , in as
characters, rather than numeric values. I'd recommend re-exporting the
data with . as the decimal separator and R should be able to deal with
it better.

Hope this helps!
--dave
